curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When history pivots in a single second, how do ordinary people caught in the immediate crosshairs handle the unfolding chaos?
curatedMovie.description: On November 22, 1963, the assassination of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas thrusts a disparate group of individuals into sudden crisis, forcing immediate, life-altering choices in the frantic wake of the shooting.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense, somber, and fast-moving, this focused historical drama demands steady attention as an intense solo watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Peter Landesman captures the immediate fallout of a world-changing event almost in real time, delivering a fast-paced historical drama driven by high-stakes human reactions.
